description: How many times n8n workflows ran in the time picker (top-right). All numbers are whole runs/requests in that window — not per-second rates. Webhook section = HTTP hits to /webhook/... URLs only (FleetOS production calls). Metrics only (Prometheus) — Loki/Tempo panels removed.

panels.description: Whole workflow runs in the selected time range (all modes: webhook, trigger, manual).
panels.title: Total Executions

panels.description: webhook / trigger / manual / … — every workflow execution.
panels.title: Executions / s by mode (all workflows)

panels.description: Success and Failed runs in the time picker (webhook + other modes). 0 = none in that window.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow_id, workflow_name, status) (round(increase(n8n_workflow_execution_duration_seconds_count[$__range])) * on(workflow_id) group_left(workflow_name) max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info))

panels.title: Runs per workflow (selected time)

panels.description: Current counter totals for 4xx/5xx (not time-range delta). Shows failures even when increase() misses the first hit or the workflow was deleted. Resets when n8n restarts.
panels.title: HTTP errors since n8n restart

targets.expr: (sum(rate(n8n_webhook_request_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]) * on(workflow_id) group_left() max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info{workflow_name=~"$workflow_name"}))) * 60 or vector(0)

sum by (workflow_id, workflow_name, method, webhook_path) (rate(n8n_webhook_request_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]) * on(workflow_id) group_left(workflow_name) max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info{workflow_name=~"$workflow_name"}))

panels.title: HTTP Requests by Webhook Path — Over Time

panels.description: Green = HTTP 2xx. Red = HTTP 4xx/5xx (401, 500, …). Failed uses webhook_path so deleted workflows still appear. Workflow can fail internally but show green here if HTTP was 200.

targets.expr: label_join(sum by (workflow_id, workflow_name, method, webhook_path) (round(increase(n8n_webhook_request_duration_seconds_count{status_code=~"[23].."}[$__range])) * on(workflow_id) group_left(workflow_name) max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info{workflow_name=~"$workflow_name"})), "endpoint", "", "workflow_name")

panels.title: HTTP Requests by Webhook Path — Success vs Failed

panels.description: Production GET/POST hits to /webhook/... in the selected time range. n8n editor Test workflow does not appear here. 0 = no FleetOS/curl calls in that window.

targets.expr: sum by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (round(increase(n8n_webhook_request_duration_seconds_count[$__range])) * on(workflow_id) group_left(workflow_name) max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info{workflow_name=~"$workflow_name"}))

panels.title: Webhook HTTP requests per workflow

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(n8n_workflow_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{mode="webhook"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(workflow_id) group_left() max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info{workflow_name=~"$workflow_name"})))

histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le) (rate(n8n_workflow_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{mode="webhook"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(workflow_id) group_left() max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info{workflow_name=~"$workflow_name"})))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(n8n_workflow_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{mode="webhook"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(workflow_id) group_left() max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info{workflow_name=~"$workflow_name"})))

sum by (workflow_id, workflow_name, method, webhook_path) (rate(n8n_webhook_request_duration_seconds_sum[$__rate_interval]) * on(workflow_id) group_left(workflow_name) max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info{workflow_name=~"$workflow_name"})) / sum by (workflow_id, workflow_name, method, webhook_path) (rate(n8n_webhook_request_duration_seconds_count[$__rate_interval]) * on(workflow_id) group_left(workflow_name) max by (workflow_id, workflow_name) (n8n_workflow_info{workflow_name=~"$workflow_name"}))
